name: Last Departure
title: Vale missed his last departure
briefing: Tidewater Consortium's security director, Lucan Vale, is preparing to abandon the district with the access ledger that names every paid informant in Northern Europe. He is hiding in plain sight among his own guards at the Signal Yard. Vale will remain inside the eastern administration block until your operatives breach his security perimeter. Once he realizes the team is close, he will walk out in a guard's uniform, sprint across the cleared forecourt to a waiting patrol car and drive east along the open service road. Vale is no fighter; he will concentrate entirely on escaping. Assassinate him before the car leaves the map. Once he is dead, assemble every surviving operative at the east-side extraction point. If Vale reaches the boundary, the operation is lost.
story: Last Departure: Lucan Vale built Tidewater's Northern Europe network by buying names, debts and loyalties. Tonight he intends to leave with the only ledger that can expose it. He looks like any other yard guard, but only one guard has a car waiting and a road out.

debrief.success: Vale never reached the border. The ledger is ash, Tidewater's informants are blind, and the team leaves the silent yard together.
debrief.failure: Vale escaped with the ledger, or the team was lost before extraction. Tidewater will replace the car by dawn; it cannot replace this opportunity.

script.text: They're inside the perimeter. I am leaving now.

objectives.description: Assassinate Director Lucan Vale before his car escapes.
After Vale is dead, assemble every surviving operative at the east-side exit.

intel: Vale's car is exposed farther east on the road beyond the cleared forecourt. He will make for it as soon as an operative enters the 12-tile security perimeter around his starting position.
Every other hostile in the yard is a patrolling guard. Vale wears the same uniform; identify him by the waiting patrol car.
